title: Direct tax mop-up grows 16% to over ₹6.51 lakh crore so far in FY27
description: Net corporate tax collection rose 22% to ₹2.40 lakh crore, and mop-up from net non-corporate tax (NCT), which includes taxes paid by individuals, HUFs, and firms, grew about 12 per cent to over ₹3.84 lakh crore till July 13
